column3: A guarded service resolves only for a kernel row, a plugin row that grants its permission, or the host's trusted context; host and kernel are provided from a kernel fiber, not the root
column4: XIN-23 reached host from a row with no permissions through ctx.fiber.parent (the entry context) and ctx.fiber.parent.get; attributing by the reading context's row closes every walk to a context that belongs to no row, and moving host off the root keeps the ancestor walk from finding it
column5: k-reach parentHost, parentGet, parentSecret, entryHost and entryGet are refused; tests that read guarded services from home.loader.ctx now use Home.services
